title: Agent capacity
description: Subscription capacity by vendor, window, and account. Live values expire after five minutes and metadata after fifteen; window identities remain for six hours. Projection uses positive six-hour and 24-hour slopes with at least three and 12 hours of data respectively; burn uses existing agent counters.
